visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair wearing a white t-shirt with a black collar trim sits on a gray fabric couch. She speaks energetically to the camera, pointing forward and gesturing with her hands. The background is a simple indoor setting with a plain off-white wall and soft beige pillows. (2) She introduces a large, pink, elongated plush toy wrapped in transparent plastic. The toy is a collaboration between Loopy and Kakao Friends. She holds it across her lap, hugging it to demonstrate its size and soft texture while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (3) The camera focuses on a purple retail box for an Evangelion EVA-01 figurine. She takes out two small, detailed figures of the EVA unit—one standard purple and one with a glowing halo—and holds them close to the lens for a macro-style view. (4) A pink box for a Chiikawa x Kakao Friends mini clock is presented. She unboxes it to show a small electronic clock featuring miniature character figures sitting on a brown tree stump base. (5) Large, colorful graphic text overlays appear on screen, displaying promotional dates '7/26-7/29' and Shopee event branding. The woman continues to speak, gesturing toward the text as it changes to show various discount percentages and shipping offers. (6) She displays two plush dolls of webtoon characters in house-shaped gift boxes with red ribbons. She then shows a lenticular card that changes the character's facial expression from neutral to a smile when tilted. She finishes by waving goodbye to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice leads the track with a fast, upbeat delivery. The background music is a bouncy electronic pop track with a bright synthesizer melody and a steady drum machine beat. Ambient noise is nearly non-existent, creating a clean studio-like feel. (2) As the speaker handles the plush toy, subtle plastic rustling noises are audible under the continuous BGM. A short 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between product descriptions. Her voice maintains high energy with frequent rising intonations. (3) A sharp 'pop' sound effect triggers as new items appear visually. The speaker's intensity increases while listing product features, and the music's percussive elements remain prominent. Small mechanical clicks are heard when she handles the figurines. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the display of promotional text. The speaker's rate of speech accelerates to cover various discount details without pauses. The BGM remains at a consistent volume relative to the vocals. (5) The final phase features a mix of 'sparkle' sound effects and a friendly, higher-pitched closing vocal. The music maintains its upbeat tempo until a sharp cut at the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Product Showcase -> Promotional Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Shopee's '2025 Online Comic Con' event by unboxing exclusive anime and webtoon merchandise while detailing available discounts and shipping offers to encourage sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the platform 'Shopee' (蝦皮) and specific promotional dates and discounts for the event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'unboxing' format typical of social media influencers to drive traffic to an e-commerce event. The combination of cute character merchandise and clear discount information serves as a strong call to action for the target demographic.
